rawFindings.title: Incorrect access to 'node.id' in VariableDeclarator check
rawFindings.explanation: The original code checked 'node.id.type' but 'node.id' is not defined on 'VariableDeclarator' after this change, leading to a potential runtime error if 'node.id' is accessed or expected. The property 'node.id' must be checked before use, or the condition must be adjusted to avoid accessing undefined properties.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the check for 'node.id.type === "Identifier"' before accessing 'node.id' to prevent runtime errors.
